curve: Cubic smoothstep RPM ramps; analytically integrated angle. Hold duration adjusted by less than one revolution to make loop close at an integer number of full turns.

source.confidence: High for transcription of manufacturer bench-test sample; not measured telemetry from a particular aircraft.
source.qualification: Manufacturer says the table represents test samples only. Startup/deceleration timing is authored for presentation; exact transient motor response is not claimed.

motion.sign_note: Positive is CCW viewed from above. Signs follow numeric blade handedness/pitch, not the historical CW/CCW filenames.
motion.stationary: Body, camera, battery, wiring, stators, windings, motor bases, bushings and screws remain stationary.
motion.simulation_scope: Synchronized stationary studio spin demonstration, with no takeoff, thrust or independent motor-control simulation.

exposure_integration.method: Time-weighted scene-linear integration of a Cycles-rendered rotational phase atlas, followed by the saved AgX view transform.
exposure_integration.approximation: Linear interpolation between 72 rotational phases over the 120-degree symmetry of three blades and three crown spokes. Finite 64/128-sided round meshes are only approximately axisymmetric; their small tessellation mismatch is not a change in dimensions.
exposure_integration.reason: A high-speed rotor turns more than 20 full revolutions during one exposure. Whole-frame orientation sampling alone can falsely freeze or reverse the blades.
